card.name: Commas after publisher or city in citations
card.fires_on: The comma right after a publisher name or publication city in a reference list entry, such as after New York, Cambridge, Springer or a press name.

modes.label: After city
modes.description: Comma following the place of publication before a state, year or publisher.
modes.example: the United States: 1999 (NCES 2001?033). U.S. Department of Education. Washington<<,>> DC: National Center for Education Statistics.

modes.label: After publisher
modes.description: Comma following a publisher name before the year or the publisher's city.
modes.example: land, David M. The Story of the Space Shuttle. Springer<<,>> 2004. Print.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated and mixed.
card.plain: It marks the comma in a bibliography entry that follows the publisher or the city of publication.
